name: Fried Rice
steps: Cook 300 grams of rice with 450ml of water in a pot, try to keep the lid on the pot while cooking.
Cut the onion, garlic, leeks, and carrots into small pieces.
Heat a pan with some oil and add the onion, corn, garlic, leeks, and carrots. Fry until soft.
Add the cooked rice to the pan and stir well.
Add 4 mixed eggs to the pan and stir until the eggs are cooked.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
